name: Korean peninsula
value: Last launch 4 Nov; Pyongyang warns 12 Nov
summary: North Korea fired missiles on 4 Nov and on 12 Nov vowed unspecified action against a US-led naval build-up
state: South Korea's military said North Korea fired multiple missiles towards the East Sea from the Sondok area on 4 Nov; Pyongyang said it had tested a new air defence system and a long-range cruise missile (Korea Herald). On 12 Nov senior party official Kim Jong-sik said North Korea would answer a US-led naval build-up with action, not only words (Korea Times, citing Yonhap). Kim Jong-un inspected a new east-coast naval base on 11 Nov (Korea Herald). No nuclear test, ICBM overflight of Japan or clash was found as of 14 Nov; the 4 Nov launch keeps Watch.
for_you: Residents and visitors in South Korea and Japan should follow local civil defence alerts. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for South Korea.
rubric_hit: Watch: ballistic/cruise missile launches on 4 Nov, within two weeks; no nuclear test, ICBM overflight or clash
